title: Lawn
description: One short bright-green grass clump for a 0.5 m yard cell: seven little three-sided tufts leaning different ways. A single mesh node `crop` (material crop), instanced by the thousand.
checks: 3/4 tile: seven separate pointed bright-green tufts, not one blob
TOP tile: the tufts stay inside the 0.5 m cell and spread over most of it
FRONT tile: the middle tuft is the tallest (0.14 m) and every tuft starts on the grid line
